# Demo 6: agents that work while you sleep, from real logs

Day 5, 0:35-0:41 (6 minutes), inside "Kinds of agents".
Terms: proactive agent, audit trail; sets up **Cron job** for 0:41.

## What the room should see

The Baraka pilot bot, deployed on Day 4, did work nobody asked for, at times nobody was at a desk, and left a record of each step.
This is the "personal AI assistant that works with the computer off" from the sales page, with a job.

## Materials (all generated by running the pilot template against fake Telegram and a fake model, `_build/sim/simulate.py`)

| What | Path |
| --- | --- |
| Every message the bot sent on its own, 14-26 Dec, with an "outside working hours" column | `tungi-xronologiya.md` |
| The owner's Telegram, week 1 and week 2 | `../../exercises/namuna/baraka-1-hafta/rahbar-telegrami.txt`, `../../exercises/namuna/baraka-2-hafta/rahbar-telegrami.txt` |
| The server log, one line per question (no names, no message text) | `../../exercises/namuna/baraka-1-hafta/server-log.txt` |
| The raw journal, one JSON line per event | `../../exercises/namuna/baraka-1-hafta/jurnal/` |

## Steps

1. Open `tungi-xronologiya.md` and scroll: 46 messages the bot sent on its own in 13 days, 19 of them before 09:00, after 18:00 or on Sunday.
   UZ: «Hech kim so‘ramagan. Bot o‘zi, jadval bo‘yicha.»
2. Three moments to point at:
   - Thursday 17 Dec, 08:00: the 1C export arrived empty; the owner knew before anyone came to work.
   - Saturday 19 Dec, 18:40: a manager asked about a 160 million tender; the bot replied that a person would answer in working hours and held the hand-over until Monday 09:00 (staff get bot messages only in working hours).
   - Monday 21 Dec, 09:00: the weekly Kit 5 file arrived by itself (`📎 kit5-raqamlar-2026-12-21.md`).
3. Show five lines of `server-log.txt`: `exchange 1a2b3c4d: answered, $0.0030, ...`.
   UZ: «Logda ism ham, xabar matni ham yo‘q: faqat raqam, holat, narx. Xodimlarga shunday va’da berilgan.»
4. Show one line of the journal (`jurnal/2026-12-16.jsonl`, the stale ErgoPro answer): question, answer, sources, cost.
   UZ: «Bu - audit izi. Nima bo‘lsa, kim, qachon, nima uchun - shu yerda. Xatolar jurnali ham shundan olinadi.»

## Honest notes

- The run is offline and the model is a set of rules; times, counts and message texts come from the real bot code on a simulated clock.
- Latency in the server log is a few milliseconds because the model is local; a real model takes 1-5 seconds.

## Fallback

The files are the demo; nothing here needs the network.
